description: Scan any codebase or logic and instantly generate rich visual diagrams—including architecture diagrams, flowcharts, Sankey diagrams, sequence diagrams, and mind maps—via zero-dependency cloud rendering URLs. Outputs ready-to-embed Markdown links by default, with on-demand export to local SVG, PNG, or standalone interactive HTML reports. Use when the user asks to visualize a repo, map architecture, trace data flows, draw a flowchart/Sankey/sequence diagram, or document system design.
